models.language: User's preferred language for the application interface. Supports Czech and English with immediate UI switching.
models.mobility: Personalized mobility settings that affect route planning and accessibility filtering. Includes wheelchair type, terrain tolerances, speed, and surface preferences.
models.visual: Visual accessibility settings for users with different visual needs. Includes high contrast mode, text sizing, and color blindness accommodations.

relationships: Language settings affect all UI text and labels throughout the app
Mobility settings are used by the routing engine to calculate accessible paths
Visual settings apply globally to all screens and components
All settings are stored locally on device without requiring authentication
